name: BUAP Codex Pet Buddy Bundle
description: Repo-backed export bundle for generating a Buddy-style Codex custom pet and wiring Codex AGENTS.md instructions to BUAP.

upstream_features.codex_app_pets: Codex App optional animated companions toggled by /pet or Appearance > Pets.
upstream_features.hatch_pet_skill: Codex skill used to create custom pets from prompts or project context.
upstream_features.agents_md: Codex instruction file mechanism for repo and personal instructions.
upstream_features.ollama_codex: Optional model-provider path for Codex CLI/App via Ollama local or cloud models.

install_modes.name: Codex App custom pet
commands_or_actions: Force Reload Skills from Codex command menu

install_modes.name: Repo behavior instructions
commands_or_actions: Copy or merge codex-pet-bundle/AGENTS.md.template into the repo root AGENTS.md
Keep repo-specific instructions above BUAP when they are more specific
Reference buddy-universal-agent-profile/AGENTS.md instead of duplicating the full BUAP contract

install_modes.name: Optional Ollama-backed Codex App
commands_or_actions: Open Codex App and select/run the target repo
Keep BUAP AGENTS.md loaded; Ollama changes model provider only

boundaries: Keep private data out of pet prompts and generated assets.
Do not claim the pet grants app or repo permissions.
Do not claim completion unless Codex/Buddy validated the work.
Keep generated local pet assets local unless the user chooses to publish them.

validation.manual: Run through tests/codex-pet-bundle.acceptance.md after generating a pet.
